Feature-direction geometry: products for features in the same group are non-zero; features from different groups are orthogonal. Each group is encoded in a 5-dimensional space.
Feature-group geometry and reconstruction error; the paper reports that orthogonality also occurs within groups as the dimensionality constraint is relieved.

Feature-group geometry and reconstruction: there is not enough dimension to allocate an orthogonal subspace to each group; features from the second and fourth groups are superposed, and reconstruction is poor.
